question.text: Why should care become uncertain when a patient returns home?

items: A son living away from his elderly parents.
A daughter unable to be with her mother when she needs her most.
A family bringing a loved one home after hospitalisation and suddenly having to manage everything on their own.

letter.quote: I have spent years trying to understand society. Now, I want to serve it.
paras: I have always believed that education is meaningful only when it helps us understand people and inspires us to make their lives better. My journey has been shaped by this belief.

During my UPSC preparation, I studied governance, public administration, society, development and the challenges faced by ordinary people. But beyond books and examinations, I began to understand the problems that families quietly face every day.
These situations made me think about a simple question: “Why should care become uncertain when a patient returns home?” That question became the beginning of this vision.

I want to build a trusted platform that connects families with hospitals, doctors, nurses, caregivers, physiotherapists, diagnostic services, pharmacies and medical equipment, making it easier for people to find the care they need at home.
letter.pull: But for me, this is not just another business idea. It is an effort to turn learning into service.
trust: When a family allows a healthcare professional into their home, they are not simply taking a service. They are trusting that person with the health, dignity and wellbeing of someone they love. That trust must be respected.
I want to build a system based on trust, compassion, accountability and dignity: a system where technology makes healthcare easier, while human care remains at its heart.

wishes.text: I want an elderly person to feel that they are not forgotten.
I want a patient returning from the hospital to feel that they are not alone.
I want families living in another city to have the comfort of knowing that someone reliable is there to support their loved ones.
And I want trained healthcare professionals to have an opportunity to serve people with dignity.

letter.closing: My UPSC journey taught me to understand society’s problems. Now, I want to use that understanding to do something about them.
letter.dream: to make healthcare more accessible, dependable and human.

vision.title: To build a trusted bridge between the hospital and the home.
vision.lead: We believe that healthcare should not stop when a patient leaves the hospital.

mission.title: To make quality home healthcare easier to find, easier to access and easier to trust.

groups.lead: Care Setu will bring different parts of the healthcare journey together on one platform:

items.name: hospitals
items.role: to create a trusted connection after discharge.

items.name: doctors and healthcare professionals
items.role: to support patients with appropriate care.

items.name: nurses and caregivers
items.role: to provide trained support at home.

items.name: diagnostics and pharmacies
items.role: to make essential healthcare services more convenient.

items.name: medical equipment partners
items.role: to provide access to equipment through rental and purchase options.

items.name: technology
items.role: to connect everything through a simple and transparent experience.

groups.change: One platform. Multiple services. One trusted connection.

values.intro: Healthcare is not only about treating an illness. It is about caring for a person.

items.name: Care
items.lead: Every patient deserves attention, respect and compassion.
items.text: Whether it is an elderly person who needs daily assistance, a patient recovering from surgery, or a family caring for someone after a long hospital stay, care should always remain personal.

items.name: Trust
items.lead: A healthcare professional entering someone’s home is being trusted with something extremely important.
items.text: We want to build that trust through clear processes, responsible service and continuous feedback.

items.name: Healing
items.lead: Treatment and healing are not always the same thing.
items.text: Treatment may happen in a hospital, but recovery can take weeks or months at home. Care Setu aims to support that journey through nursing, physiotherapy, rehabilitation, follow-up care and long-term support.

items.name: Home
items.lead: Home is where people feel most comfortable and secure.
items.text: Whenever clinically appropriate, we want to make it easier for people to receive dependable healthcare support without leaving the familiarity and dignity of their own home.

promise.lead: There is someone we can depend on.
lines: But throughout the journey of care.
promise.close: Because sometimes, the best support we can give a family is simply to be there.
